text:
sam: Quick proposal — run a phased experiment for the new smart-fallback routing policy across regions. feature flag + progressive canary + small A/B slice for quality checks. thinking: EU -> NA -> APAC cadence.

anya: +1. Can you write the rollout steps? want launch criteria and rollback triggers up front. also: which KPIs we watch? :eyes:

sam: rough steps: 1) enable feature flag off in prod 2) 1% traffic canary (EU) for 30m 3) expand 5% (EU) 2h 4) 20% (EU+NA) 6h + start A/B quality evals 5) 50% global 6) 100% if stable. rollback if thresholds hit.

kevin (eng-runtime): We can implement the flag and split percentages easily. suggest automated gating: fail if error_rate increase > 0.3% over baseline for 10m OR p95 latency > baseline + 250ms for 10m. also track fallback_rate (how often we drop to lower-cost variant) and prompt-quality regression (see lia).

lia (product-analytics): For A/B quality: sample 1k requests per variant per region and run eval set (synthetic prompts + customer-supplied golden prompts). Primary metrics: completion-quality score delta, fallback_rate, user-facing error rate. Secondary: cost delta per token. Acceptance: quality delta <= 1.5% degradation and no >25% increase in fallback_rate.

ash (note: not in thread)

ash: (added in convo via DM) would prefer an experiment tag in telemetry so we can filter traces easily.

ash: also recommend ramp windows during low-traffic hours per region.

ash: propose schedule snippet: 
```
EU: 1% x30m -> 5% x2h -> 20% x6h -> 50% x4h -> 100%
NA: wait until EU 20% stable then 1% -> 5% -> 20%
APAC: follow NA with 12h buffer
```

ash: can we add golden prompt checks at each step?

kevin (eng-runtime): yes. we'll run evals in the canary pool before expanding. need to know the SLAs for queueing: if queue depth spikes, we should auto-shed canary traffic rather than expand.

ash: SRE runbook items: notify oncall at start of each major step, open a temporary incident channel, set automated rollback thresholds, and expose a one-click kill-switch.

ash (eng-sre): written runbook stub: 
- pre-check: golden prompts baseline ok
- start canary: tag deploy with experiment_id
- monitor: p50/p95 latency, error_rate, fallback_rate, quality_score
- gating: if any gating metric crosses threshold for >10m -> auto-rollback + notify #incidents
- post-mortem if rollback happens

sam: feature flag config example: 
```json
{
  "flag": "smart_fallback_v2",
  "variants": ["control", "soft_fallback", "hard_fallback"],
  "canary_percent": 1,
  "stages": [1,5,20,50,100],
  "regions": ["eu","na","apac"],
  "auto_rollback": true
}
```

anya: love the config. Couple of negotiation points for product / sales: some enterprise customers will want control over rollout in their dedicated zones. we should add an allowlist for dedicated customers so they can opt in/out.

kevin: add allowlist param to flag system, yep. Also call out cost controls — quantization/variant selection for canary should prefer cheaper model variant when running A/B to keep cost predictable.

ash (eng-sre): oncall note — add synthetic traffic generator for golden prompts in each region so quality evals run continuously during canary.

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary start: 1782350000 for EU 1% (smart_fallback_v2). Initiated by sam. :rocket:

anya: next steps: i) finalize gating thresholds ii) document runbook + oncall steps iii) add dedicated-customer allowlist iv) schedule canary windows per region. I'll own the launch checklist.

sam: thanks. i'll create the PR with flag + traffic matrix and link the runbook. will tag owners on the PR.

kevin: ping me once PR is up, i'll wire the runtime hooks and automated rollback.

ash: i'll finish the runbook and synthetic traffic job tomorrow AM.

lia: will set up the A/B evaluation dashboards and alerting.

sam: good sync, keeping this thread for updates. :white_check_mark:
